name: smartattend-monorepo
description: SmartAttend Attendance System - Fullstack repository containing Express backend API and Next.js admin frontend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
